senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גָּרַר, v. גּוֹרֶן, גּוּרְנָא)store-room; bin for wheat, figs &c.; reservoir.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 4b:1">Pes. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ מליאה פירות</he> a store-house full of provision.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:8">Maasr. I, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00089"><he>עָגַל</he></cite>; a. e.—

Tosef. Mikv. I, 17 מ׳ של דיסקוס וכ׳ (ed. Zuck. ינורס, corr. acc.) the water-reservoir of Discus in Jabneh; Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵇ מְגוֹרֶת של וכ׳; Kidd. 66ᵇ מ׳ של דסקים.—Trnsf. (v. אֲגוֹרָה) pericarp of nuts, almonds &c.; drupe.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:2">Maasr. I, 2</cite> nuts are subject to tithes <he>משיעשו מ׳</he> from the time they form drupes; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:1">Tosef. ib. I, 1</cite>; Y. ib. I, 48ᵈ bot.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18:3">Gen. R. s. 18</cite> <he>בנה בה מגורות וכ׳</he> (read <cite ref="M00143"><he>מְגוֹרֶת</he></cite>) he built in woman’s body one store-room (the womb) more than in man; (<cite ref="Eruvin 18a">Erub. 18ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>כבנין אוצר</he>).—Pl. <he>מְגוּרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:6">B. Bath. IV, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 67b:6">67ᵇ</cite>) <he>מ׳ שלמים</he> (Ms. M. <he>מערות</he>) reservoirs.
Kel. XIX, 7 מ׳ שבה the drawers in a chest.
Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. II, 7 בית תבלין … העשוי מ׳ מ׳ וכ׳ a wooden spice box having compartments (partitions) without lids.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:1">B. Mets. VIII, 1</cite> <he>שידה שהמ׳ שלה וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>מגירות</he>, corr. acc.) a chest whose drawers are inside (not protruding).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 992:25">Yalk. Cant. 992</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00280"><he>אֲגוֹרָה</he></cite>.
